description: Implement a solution to isolate column preferences for join relationship tables from the main collection list view preferences. Currently, join tables share the same preference storage key as their related collection's list view, causing defaults from one to overwrite the other. The fix should scope join table preferences to the parent join field path and ensure all join fields pass necessary parent metadata for proper isolation.
functional_requirements: Modify the join field component to key its table state using the parent document field path instead of the related collection key
Update the table state resolution utility to accept and use parent metadata from all join fields, including monomorphic joins
Add an end-to-end test that verifies opening a join table with admin.defaultColumns configured does not affect the related collection's list view columns
